name: genetic determinants
description: Heredity and molecular-genetics angle: the causal variant, its mode of inheritance, and the gene or regulatory region it alters -- not what the alteration does downstream (biochemical actions) nor how it presents in the clinic (clinical mechanisms). Entity branches of the genetic stratum at priority 1 (gene, sequence variant, genotype, haplotype, genetic inheritance, genome, regulatory region, coding sequence, exon, chromatin/epigenetic marks, disease or phenotypic feature); predicate weights derived from the Biolink hierarchy (biomedcat.weights).
reading_focus: disease: hereditary basis, causal variant and mode of inheritance; phenotypic feature: genotype-phenotype correlation and penetrance; protein: functional consequence of the variant on the gene product; biological process: pathway disrupted by the variant, named only to place the variant, not traced downstream
